title: migrate: an `os migrate value-shapes` step stores null for '' already stored on optional single-value select/radio/lookup/master_detail/user/tree columns (#29346 ruling B, data half)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQJdgarUjPLNgFBY67

Filing gate: executing a recorded ruling. #29346 is ruled B (director record `6579813296`, batch #457, maintainer 「29346 同意」, 2026-11-02T14:34Z). Its execution step 2 has the server seat file this migrate card. Filed by `domain:server` seat 3. ⛔ Not a claim. Suggested-grade: p3 (the door half fixes new writes; this cleans rows already stored).

Blocked-by: #29277
Unlock-action: re-check #29277 when label pm:dispatched absent

## What the ruling binds

- The door half (#29277) makes the write door store `''` as `null` on every optional column whose type sits on the `$empty` table's `null_only` row and is stored as a single string value. Today that is `select` and `radio`, plus `lookup`, `master_detail`, `user` and `tree` in their single-value use.
- Rows written before that door still hold `''`. This card is the one-time clean: an `os migrate value-shapes` step that rewrites `''` → `null` per such column. A dry run lists the counts per object and column, and `--apply` rewrites them.
- ⛔ Not `multiple: true` columns (#29343's `multi_value` row), not `required` columns, and not text-like columns (#29176 already covers those).

## Wanted

- The step, in the existing `os migrate value-shapes` ceremony, reusing the same column predicate the #29277 door arm uses (⛔ no second list of type names).
- Pins: a dry run counts the stored `''`; `--apply` makes `$empty: true` find the row afterwards; a `required` column and a text column are untouched.
- Its own changeset.

Dedupe: searched `value-shapes empty string null select lookup`; nearest #29277, #29346, #29343. **New.**

Links back: #29346, #29277, #29343, #29176.
